design_system.usage: The standard for building ArDrive app UI on any platform: theme tokens for dark and light, type scale, spacing, radii, components and copy rules. Use it for product screens; this file covers the brand layer only.

logos.name: Icon
logos.usage: The mark on a transparent ground, with its own light outline. Works on dark and light backgrounds.

logos.name: Icon on dark plate
logos.usage: Preferred version where a square plate is needed, such as an avatar or app icon.

logos.name: Icon on light plate
logos.usage: A square plate on light surfaces.

logo_rules: Do not alter the logo's colours, proportions or orientation.
Keep clear space around every variant of at least the height of the icon.
Do not place the logo on a background without enough contrast.

colors.name: Primary
colors.usage: CTAs, primary buttons and key accents.

colors.name: Ruddy
colors.usage: The logo mark, decorative highlights and glows. Not for buttons or text: white on Ruddy fails WCAG AA.

color_rules: There is no brand warning or error colour. Errors use the reds. Warnings are neutral greys with a warning icon; never add yellow, orange or pink.
Dark is the default theme; light is first class. App UI takes every colour from the theme tokens in the design system spec.

primary.fallback: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
primary.license: Licensed face. ArDrive apps get the font files from the ArDrive team; everyone else uses the fallback stack.

weights.300: 42 Light: large figures only, such as amounts and sizes at heading sizes

primary.weights_note: CSS weights to declare in @font-face. The files declare Light as 400 and Book as 500; text with no weight set must be Book, never Light. 28 Thin is never used.
primary.figures: Proportional only, no tabular figures. Right-align number columns; give a figure that changes in place a fixed width.
primary.scripts: Latin only. Other scripts use the system font through the fallback stack.

monospace.usage: Code, text-file previews and note editors; transaction, file and drive IDs, wallet addresses and keys. Names (ArNS, ENS, SNS) stay in Wavehaus.

rules: Sentence case for labels, buttons and titles.
Minimal text: no description that restates its label.

terms.Turbo Credits: The product name. Lowercase "credits" after an amount, shown to 4 decimal places.
terms.address: A wallet address only, never a name or a web location.
terms.snapshot: The user's word for a saved drive state.
